notes: Smallest round-trip on Hermes: one plain-text prompt via the `hermes chat` REPL, one assistant reply, no tool use. Hermes writes no transcript file — the daemon observes the shared SQLite store at $HERMES_HOME/state.db (ProcessOwnedStore), where role='user' drives ready→working and an assistant row with finish_reason='stop' drives working→ready. The sessions row is INSERTed only on the first user message (~2s after launch), so there is no store-derived ready birth at launch: session_birth is anchored to recording start and left UNPINNED so the transient proc-<PID> pre-session that carries the ready birth cannot steal identity and cascade same_session_as failures, and turn1_done chains off turn1_start instead (the opencode ProcessOwnedStore shape). The 'no state_transition to waiting' invariant covers tool_calls_max:0 — a no-tool turn never gates on a permission ask. NO metric hard-assertion is pinned in observations, and that is deliberate. `of verify` hard-asserts ONLY against the newest recording's replay golden summary (validate/observations.go:135-161 → readGoldenSummary l.91-107), and tokens_nonzero reads cum_input+cum_output off that golden (l.37, l.177-179). Hermes' tokens never reach it: they live on the `sessions` AGGREGATE row and are read by ComputeMetrics over the store — a path replay never runs — while hermes' Parser sets no token field at all (parser.go carries no Usage/CumulativeTokens/InputTokens; contrast opencode, whose per-step `tokens` on each message row is why its golden does carry cum tokens). A hermes golden would therefore read 0 and tokens_nonzero would HARD-FAIL; cost_nonzero fails identically (the golden's cost is the tailer's, derived from those same zero tokens), and total_tokens_nonzero is gated `adapter == antigravity.AdapterName` in cmd/replay/metrics.go:59. On top of that the hermes driver exports no store→JSONL transcript today (opencode's driver builds one via sqlite3 json_object; grep finds no equivalent in hermes'), so a hermes recording yields no transcript.jsonl and hence no golden — ValidateObservations returns Skipped and any pin here would be a promise nothing checks. The token/cost evidence is carried instead by the recipe's verify[] against the LIVE metrics surface at record time; the unlock is to extend the #766 golden lift (and a store export) to hermes the way #775/#776 did for antigravity. model stays unpinned per #440 — the recorded model is whatever model.default the run's HERMES_HOME carries.

text: A hermes session appears in ready shortly after launch; nothing ever enters waiting (no tool use)
A PID is bound to the session (Hermes is a Python console script, matched on the full command line)
The user prompt drives the store-backed session ready → working
The single turn completes back to ready on the same session (assistant row with finish_reason='stop' → turn_done)
